claims.statement: For uniform equal-mean balanced Boolean selector branches, rank one of the branch-by-data-frequency Fourier matrix forces every branch to be a signed copy of one Boolean core. The selector factors as F(a,x)=sigma(a)g(x), so H(F)=H(sigma)+H(g) and I(F)=I(sigma)+I(g). Independently certified component FEI constants therefore combine by their maximum.
claims.quantifiers: All finite uniform address and data cubes; all genuine balanced Boolean branches; exact spectral rank one.
scope_exclusions: No claim for spectral rank greater than one
No universal estimate for an arbitrary sign controller
No use of disjoint-support K_eff under complete branch collision

claims.statement: For F_t(a,x)=h_t(a)Maj_3(x), where h_t is -1 at exactly one address, the literal branch cover has worst read k=2^t, fractional congestion one, spectral rank one, expected controller-root cost 2-2^{1-t}<2, and H(F_t)<4I(F_t) for every t>=1.
claims.quantifiers: Every integer t>=1 on the uniform (t+3)-dimensional Boolean cube.
scope_exclusions: The family is not a full-FEI counterexample
